repo.description: A library for accelerating Transformer models on NVIDIA GPUs, including using 8-bit and 4-bit floating point (FP8 and FP4) precision on Hopper, Ada and Blackwell GPUs, to provide better performance with lower memory utilization in both training and inference.

detail.body:
## Summary

Adds an opt-in fused prepare + dispatch path for the JAX EP frontend (`NVTE_EP_FUSED_PREPARE_DISPATCH=1`, default off), mirroring PyTorch's `nvte_ep_prepare_and_dispatch`.

Also fixes the unfused path: `ep_dispatch` now returns `handle_mem` as an aliased XLA output, making the forward/backward data dependency visible to the scheduler and removing the need to force `NCCL_EP_HT_EM_AG_SCAN_MODE=1`.

`ep_prepare` and `ep_dispatch_fwd` are deprecated in favor of `ep_prepare_and_dispatch_fwd`, with removal planned for January 2027.

## Implementation

- `EpPrepareAndDispatchPrimitive`: fused FFI call returning `recv_tokens`, `recv_topk_weights`, `token_counts`, `total_recv_tokens`, `handle_mem`.
- `tex.ep_prepare_and_dispatch_fwd`: single entry point that selects the fused or unfused path from `NVTE_EP_FUSED_PREPARE_DISPATCH` (latched on first use). Called by both `ep_dispatch` and `_moe_fwd_rule`; neither branches itself.
- `tex.ep_prepare` / `tex.ep_dispatch_fwd`: now emit a `DeprecationWarning`. The unfused path calls private `_ep_prepare` / `_ep_dispatch_fwd`, so internal use does not warn.
- `EpDispatchPrimitive`: `operand_output_aliases={0: 2}` enforces dispatch -> combine ordering; backward now uses `ncclEpImportHandle` on the post-dispatch `handle_mem`.
- Shared C++ buffer helper rejects non-float32 `topk_weights` on both paths.
- `examples/jax/ep/bench/ep_bench.py`: `run_dispatch` unpacks the new `handle_mem` return value.
- Env var documented in `docs/envvars.rst`.


## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation change (change only to the documentation, either a fix or a new content)
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [x] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Infra/Build change
- [ ] Code refactoring

# Checklist:

- [x] I have read and followed the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.rst)
- [x] The functionality is complete
- [x] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [x] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [x] My changes generate no new warnings
- [x] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [x] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes

inline_comments.body: **MoE ignores the new option** Setting `NVTE_EP_FUSED_PREPARE_DISPATCH=1` only switches `ep_dispatch`. The full `moe` path calls `tex.ep_prepare` and `tex.ep_dispatch_fwd` directly, and the Flax `_MoEBlock` calls `moe`. Those users still run separate prepare and dispatch calls despite enabling the documented option. Apply the same latched choice in the full MoE forward path, keeping its counts, handle, and backward results unchanged. **Knowledge Base Used:** [JAX distributed and MoE execution](https://app.greptile.com/nvidia-public-github/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/nvidia/transformerengine/-/docs/jax-distributed-moe.md)

+class EpPrepareAndDispatchPrimitive(BasePrimitive):
+    """FFI primitive for nvte_ep_prepare_and_dispatch: fused prepare + dispatch (forward)."""
+
+    name = "te_ep_prepare_and_dispatch_ffi"
+    multiple_results = True
+    impl_static_args = (3, 4, 5, 6)  # top_k, dispatch_output_per_expert_alignment,
+    #                                  recv_capacity_per_rank, is_outer
+    inner_primitive = None
+    outer_primitive = None

+    @staticmethod
+    def abstract(
+        topk_idx_aval,
+        tokens_aval,
+        topk_weights_aval,
+        *,
+        top_k,
+        dispatch_output_per_expert_alignment,
+        recv_capacity_per_rank,
+        is_outer,
+    ):
+        del topk_idx_aval, topk_weights_aval
+        assert (
+            len(tokens_aval.shape) >= 2
+        ), f"tokens must be at least 2D [..., H], got shape {tokens_aval.shape}"
+        cfg = get_ep_config()
+        handle_mem_size = int(

+        leading = _ep_leading_dims(is_outer)
+        tok_dtype = dtypes.canonicalize_dtype(tokens_aval.dtype)
+        recv_tokens_aval = jax.core.ShapedArray(
+            leading + (recv_capacity_per_rank, tokens_aval.shape[-1]), tok_dtype
+        )
+        recv_topk_weights_aval = jax.core.ShapedArray(
+            leading + (recv_capacity_per_rank,), jnp.float32
+        )
+        token_counts_aval = jax.core.ShapedArray(leading + (cfg.num_local_experts,), jnp.int32)

Confidence Score: 5/5

**[High impact]** No new blocking issue was established in this review.

Summary

Adds an opt-in fused prepare-and-dispatch path for JAX EP. - JAX can run expert prepare and dispatch as one operation. - Dispatch returns its handle buffer as an output. - The old JAX prepare and dispatch helpers now warn callers to switch. No new actionable findings were established.
